title: Manifold constrained steepest descent for smooth and closed-set optimization
summary: We study minimization of smooth functions over feasible sets that have smooth embedded-manifold structure throughout or only on selected regions, using linear minimization oracles (LMOs) to determine search directions under user-chosen norms. Restricting an LMO to a tangent space, however, can require an iterative inner solve. We propose \emph{Manifold Constrained Steepest Descent} (MCSD) and a tangent-projected variant, MCSD-TP, which avoid solving tangent-space LMO subproblems iteratively.
